name: 86 Chaos 16.0.236
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.236
notes: Introduces a dormant, server-only POS Bridge v1 foundation for a future separate 86 Chaos POS.
Adds ES256 machine installation authentication, durable replay protection, short-lived access tokens, strict allowlist event schemas, immutable staged receipts and bounded sequence evidence.
Reserves all bridge roots from generic writes and ordinary backup restore while preserving default-denied client Firestore access.
Stages evidence only: no POS event changes inventory, financials, schedules, time clock, payroll, menu, recipes, vendors, pars or customer records.
